name: com.hawkes.net
description: Multiplayer for Unity games on Hawkes Net (https://net.hawkesgen.com): shared rooms by area (HawkesNetLobby: live and test rooms, shards when full, rejoining), drop-in avatars (HawkesNetAvatars), and rooms with messages, poses, peers, the host and a shared clock (HawkesNet.Join). WebGL builds run Hawkes Net's web SDK in the page; the Editor and desktop builds join the same rooms with a managed client. Players in the background show as away, and an away host hands the room on.

samples.description: One script: a capsule you walk with WASD and everyone else in the room, through HawkesNetAvatars.
